## a. LAW_INDEX — verbatim @ `d449889e`

```
# LAW INDEX — one line per standing law; dispatches cite IDs. Fetch this file before any dispatch.
L0  CANON crediting: trades-as-truth kiss=credit; strict channel build-verification only (e073c606, fb74c8b8)
L1  Machine record beats reconstruction; reconstructions ANALYTICAL until executable-confirmed (61b47a84)
L2  Census-tautology void: classifier embedding its conclusion (fdeb7516→12d67c8a)
L3  Lane-or-dedupe on raw traces (f36798fc)
L4  Fill-class fingerprint on every credited leg cited (528d75e4)
L5  Count-carries-leg-and-window (a37bf6a6)
L6  Formation law: pre-onset fills say nothing about judgment (9eff493b, 1d5564b5)
L7  Frame-check/PRIOR-ART on every analysis reply ("outcomes audited, causes assumed" template)
L8  Data-source law: Kalshi trades yes, historical depth no; recorder = book truth (db470ec8)
L9  Queue informational never gating; kiss=credit untouched (1d5564b5)
L10 Vocabulary locks: bought/bid/prints/book-side; checks bind to lawful behavior never outcomes; "bell"→FULL-804 EXAM; priors-inform-never-gate
L11 Truth table = sole window source; bells verified-or-UNKNOWN (c0056976); grading binds to it (fc17d0d3)
L12 Causal onset: no right-edge term; edge-perturbation independence asserted (6678fd0c) — LINEAGE
L13 Ripeness is per-class and per-coordinate; snapshot accuracy ≠ policy accuracy — gates validate at policy grain only (41c1f724, 71de534a)
L14 AIM-PAST-THE-MARKET: static/library depth targets sit below reachable floors; running session low beats every static depth (8b4483fb STOOD_TOO_DEEP · 71de534a DOWN-2¢ · ab609761 frontier · 1c9419a0 240g/1,201¢ default-lane)
L15 Fraction-of-span gates NOT-LIVE-REALIZABLE in the tail; live clock = min(schedule, in-play guard), error measured (620fe4c1)
L16 Anchor = spread-settle mid at formation end; series floored at formation end (620fe4c1, a059264d parity 139,430/139,430)
L17 BASELINE: V52l lineage — 311 completes / 714¢ / 46% games / 23% cents of 680/3,123¢ (96597c98); supersedes 214/350
L18 DISPATCH LICENSE (this fold): every dispatch to any seat must open with the LAW_INDEX SHA it was read at and the law IDs consulted; SEATS REFUSE dispatches lacking this block — enforcement is the receiver's, not memory's
L19 EXAM STAGING: no FULL-804 for any mechanism without a passed fresh-30 (5 pins + 25 fresh, new seed, zero cohort overlap) of the identical mechanism, claims pre-stated in the operator's two measurements (chat stratum, filed 2026-08-19)
L20 FINDINGS BANKING: every new learning is banked at discovery as a numbered F-<iteration>-### line (one-sentence claim + receipt SHA + status NEW/SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS) in the iteration's FINDINGS ledger, same commit as its evidence; unbanked findings may not be cited (operator ruling 2026-08-19)
L21 STANDING PUSH: L18-licensed dispatch commits push to origin at commit time (iteration/analysis/docs branches); live-engine modification/deployment still requires the operator's explicit word (operator ruling 2026-08-19; supersedes per-commit PUSH AUTHORIZED)
L22 ARTIFACT TRANSPORT CAP: no newly committed file exceeds 50 MB; oversize artifacts go to external custody with path+sha256+bytes+rows manifest (operator ruling 2026-08-19)
L23 PAIR-UNIT PROOF: a game is one unit with two polar expressions; no bid stands without a single joint license naming both legs' states, both stances (late-floor side, early-floor side), and the split of the pair's budget; two leg decisions sharing a budget is a defect class, not a pair (operator ruling 2026-08-20)
```

The L6 first read-level target is written on an unformed book in ~1/3 of Stage-1 games (V53-02 11/30, V53-03 12/30, V53-04B 10/30): targets of 4–11¢ against a post-only ask bound of 85–94¢ (SALARN|ARN 5¢ vs 94¢, MERDRO|MER 6¢ vs 93¢, MARCOL|COL 5¢ vs 94¢). MERDRO's and MARCOL's pre-formation credits are these first targets kissed by formation-era prints. L6 formation law: pre-onset fills say nothing about judgment.

- Exam-era absolute figures (all V53 Stage-1 scorecards, every "x of 30" and "y¢ locked" in d.1) were graded on the OLD ruler: closes from INDEPENDENT_CLOSE_AUDIT_1608 (`a30f5ccd`), offers from the 612-census (`22441e05`), no truth-table binding — contrary to L11 (F-VS-003). ### d.7 Denominator incoherence and its resolution
Exam #4's scoreboard printed 4 offered against 23 completed (F-V53-039) because the 612-census is coverage-limited: 25 of the 30 games are NOT_BOUND in it (F-VS-001). Resolution on record (F-VS-002, `ce2e8b7c`): ONE denominator — valid-fill completes ÷ truth-table OFFERED_UNDER_PAR on the 680 basis, UNKNOWN_BELL excluded both sides. The embargo on offered-percentages lifts on that definition only.

## e. The operator's two measurements — current form

All figures are discount measurements on the fixed 804 (Jul 12–20), truth table @ `c0056976` the sole window source (L11).

**Measurement 1 — offered.** Both legs under par inside the verified pre-match span, print-backed: **680 of 804 games = 84.6%**, total margin **3,123¢**, i.e. **≈4.6¢ per offered game** (`96597c98` binding `c0056976`). Ladder: 58 games ≥10¢ (817¢) · 265 ≥5¢ (2,157¢) · 435 ≥3¢ (2,743¢) · 245 thin 1–2¢ (380¢).

**Measurement 2 — completes of offered.** L17 baseline, V52l lineage, honest ruler: **311 / 680 = 45.7%** of offered games, **714¢ = 22.9%** of offered cents (`96597c98`). Average locked game delta on completes **714/311 ≈ 2.3¢** against the offer's ≈4.6¢/game. Standing comparisons: V52r own census 300/662¢ (≈2.2¢); V52s 310/581¢ (operator-reserved); the pre-ruler honest scoreboard 214/350¢ with 139 of 214 completes at exactly 1¢ (`2aa454af`, superseded by L17 as baseline, method retained).

**Both rulers, defined (F-V53-024):**
- Game delta = 100¢ − (entry A + entry B), both legs credited, combined entries strictly below 100; graded only on fills inside the truth-table span (formation-lawful, pre-bell).
- Leg delta = that leg's own W1 close − the leg's credited entry; reported per leg, never summed into the game delta.

**Organ breakdown of the misses — restated in full from `1c9419a0`** (380 offered-not-completed games = 345 PARTIAL + 35 NEITHER; 415 unbought legs; floors verified 415/415 against the lane ledger):

| organ | games | cents | share of missing cents | note |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| STOOD_TOO_DEEP | 240 | 1,201¢ | 76% | 341 of 415 unbought legs; licensed rest sat a few cents below the printed floor; gap median 1¢, 58% of too-deep moments exactly 1¢ (`d211505b`) |
| authority-not-earned | 37 | 152¢ | 10% | read never licensed a level before the floor passed |
| STOOD_ELSEWHERE (post-bell kisses) | 16 | 179¢ | 11% | the rest was kissed after the bell — not a valid fill |
| onset-blocked | 6 | 37¢ | 2% | no causal onset before the floor |
| thin ≤1¢ abstentions | 79 | 79¢ | banded apart | 1¢ offers; not pursued by design |
| pair-lows blocks | 0 | 0 | — | removed at V52h and stayed removed |

Licenses on the lane total 195¢ of the 1,201¢ too-deep cents. Depth of fill is rule-insensitive (fill − floor median 2¢, `ab609761`); the binding question is whether a stand kisses at all.

## f. The standing diagnosis

1. **The per-game understanding organ was never built.** Every lane since V52 stood on population constants (depth aggregates, percentile targets, role libraries) or on history (session lows). The record shows depth is a per-moment market fact (L14) and history is lawful as neither address, bound nor budget (F-V53-015/022).
2. **Five challengers plus the census closed five mechanisms:** history-as-address (V53-01), history-as-bound (V53-02), history-as-budget (V53-02/03), arming-timing (V53-04/04b — earliest gates outcome-identical to control), reactive capture (V53-05 census 0/33).
3. **The sole mechanism the data permits:** early standing on the strengthening side from a per-game picture. Riser floors sit at 0.05–0.23 of the span (their floor ≈ the open), faller floors at 0.78–0.99; 25 of 26 dead pairs across the Stage-1s were single-credited — one side bought, the sibling never armed (F-V53-019/020). The pair is one unit with a time-inverted sibling stance (L23).
4. **V54 — the pair model — is its first build** (branch `codex/window1-v54-pair-model-20260821`, tip `75e02d98`; module `arb-executor/analysis/window1_v54_pair_model.js`, 333 lines, tests in `tests/test_window1_v54_pair_model.js`): type-forced polarity (the pair resolves to one strengthening side or stays UNDECIDED and the frozen champion owns both levels), sentence licenses per receipt naming both legs' states, stances and the budget split, pins-passed no-damage (4/117¢ byte-equal to V52l, `4c130234`), iteration 01 running on the fixed 804 under the honest ruler (L19a).
5. **Next read = the twelve-game check set before any aggregate** (F-V53-040): seven known dead-sibling games (ARSMAR, TANHAV, MARCOL, DIEMON, ROCBUE, ITOKNU, RODINC) + five known champion completes (KUMTUR, POLKUH, SANDAN, FERZAN, PUTJEA). **Build-1 reading (CC, from `CHECK_SET_12.md` @ 4c130234, filed F-VS-014):** V54 is byte-equal to the champion on all twelve — 7 PARTIAL_ONE_LEG_ONLY and 5 COMPLETE_UNDER_PAR_VALID on both rulers; polarity is UNDECIDED on 8,583 of 8,585 written licenses because ROLE_INSTRUMENT_NOT_RESOLVED_ON_BOTH_EXPRESSIONS (the other 2: ROLE_DISAGREES_WITH_PRESSURE_DIRECTION). The pair model has not yet engaged on any of the twelve; the no-damage proof holds; the mechanism proof has not started. Full-804 aggregate does not proceed until the twelve read sane — as of build 1 they read inert, not sane.
